checks.command:
PYTHONPATH=/workspace-SR008.nfs2/vkropotin/optimization-task/gift:/workspace-SR008.nfs2/vkropotin/optimization-task/runs/flash-qla /opt/torchtitan-venv/bin/python3.12 -c 'import measure; import torchtitan.components.loss as loss; import torchtitan.distributed.deepep.hybridep as hybridep; import torchtitan.distributed.deepep.routing as routing; import torchtitan.experiments.four_fusion.routing_metadata as fused; import torchtitan.experiments.four_fusion.stable_ce as stable; native_hybrid_route = hybridep.indices_to_map; native_stable_ce = stable.cross_entropy_loss; classes = (loss.CrossEntropyLoss, loss.ChunkedCELoss, loss.MTPLoss); initializers = tuple(cls.__init__ for cls in classes); cases = (("original", "original"), ("original", "stable"), ("fused", "original"), ("fused", "stable"));
for route_choice, ce_choice in cases:
    expected_route = routing.indices_to_map if route_choice == "original" else fused.indices_to_map
    expected_ce = loss.cross_entropy_loss if ce_choice == "original" else native_stable_ce
    with measure._bind_native_fusion_choices(route_choice, ce_choice) as receipt:
        assert hybridep.indices_to_map is expected_route
        made = (loss.CrossEntropyLoss.Config().build(), loss.ChunkedCELoss.Config(num_chunks=2).build(), loss.MTPLoss.Config(num_chunks=2, loss_weights=[0.3]).build())
        assert all(measure._unwrap_compiled_callable(item.fn) is expected_ce for item in made)
        assert len(receipt["constructed_loss_callables"]) == 3
    assert hybridep.indices_to_map is native_hybrid_route and stable.cross_entropy_loss is native_stable_ce
    assert tuple(cls.__init__ for cls in classes) == initializers
print("4 actual native TorchTitan selection combinations passed; each constructed CE/MTP callable matched; bindings restored")'
